text: {"items":[{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(b)","exact_quote":"they indicate unwillingness to satisfy debts"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(c)","exact_quote":"The record evidence supports a conclusion that Applicant has a history of unresolved financial problems."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(f)","exact_quote":"Accordingly, the record evidence is sufficient to show that Applicant’s failure to file federal income tax returns since tax year 2002 was in violation of 26 U.S.C. § 7203."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(a)","exact_quote":"Her criminal conduct was recent and not isolated."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(b)","exact_quote":"her indebtedness was due to circumstances within her control"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(d)","exact_quote":"she has not made a good- faith effort to resolve the indebtedness"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(e)","exact_quote":"Applicant does not have a reasonable basis to dispute the debts"}]}

{"items":[{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(a)","exact_quote":"The record evidence is more than sufficient to establish these two disqualifying conditions, which raise a security concern."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(c)","exact_quote":"The record evidence supports a conclusion that Applicant has a history of financial problems."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(d)","exact_quote":"The four major debts for a total of about $13,350 are being addressed through the repayment plan."}]}

{"items":[{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(a)","exact_quote":"he defaulted on the car loan opened in May 2010 (SOR ¶ 1.j) because he could not afford the monthly payment"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(c)","exact_quote":"Three accounts totaling $3,696 for telecommunications and electricity services were placed for collection in the 1.5 years preceding Applicant’s security clearance hearing"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(e)","exact_quote":"Applicant exercised poor financial judgment by taking on more debt than he could afford on his income."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(a)","exact_quote":"The debts in the SOR were incurred in the last five years, after Applicant had been afforded a fresh financial start through bankruptcy"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(b)","exact_quote":"To the extent that Applicant’s ability to repay his debts has been compromised because of the loss of spousal income, his ongoing financial difficulties cannot completely be attributed to factors outside of his control."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(c)","exact_quote":"has some applicability in this case, but only to the automobile loan deficiency in SOR ¶ 1.j"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(d)","exact_quote":"Albeit in response to a June 2013 financial judgment, Applicant has been repaying the debt at $150 per month since September 2013."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(e)","exact_quote":"Applicant is liable since he was also on the lease."}]}

{"items":[{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(c)","exact_quote":"Applicant’s delinquent debts are recent and numerous"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(a)","exact_quote":"Applicant’s delinquent debts are recent and numerous, but they were incurred under circumstances making them unlikely to recur."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(b)","exact_quote":"a disabling injury in 2009; the birth of a special-needs daughter; a pay reduction"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(c)","exact_quote":"She has acted responsibly by seeking financial counseling"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(d)","exact_quote":"staying in contact with creditors, and systematically paying or making payments to her creditors."}]}

{"items":[{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(f)","exact_quote":"Applicant, for various reasons, including negligence, failed to file tax returns for several years"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(d)","exact_quote":"eventually, he determined that it was in his best interest to file all the applicable tax returns, which he has done"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(g)","exact_quote":"As a result of his filing of the tax returns, both the state and Federal tax authorities have released their liens"},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(a)","exact_quote":"He credibly indicates that this conduct will not occur in the future"}]}

{"items":[{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(c)","exact_quote":"Applicant fell behind on her debts due to health issues, as well as her husband’s employment instability and frequent moves."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(a)","exact_quote":"She accrued delinquent debts of about $15,465."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(b)","exact_quote":"Applicant’s financial difficulties were caused by circumstances beyond her control."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(b)","exact_quote":"Applicant’s health issues and her husband’s unstable employment led her to incur numerous delinquent debts."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(d)","exact_quote":"She undertook a documented good-faith effort to repay her creditors."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(d)","exact_quote":"While not all of her debts have been paid, she has established that her debts are being resolved."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(a)","exact_quote":"Her finances have stabilized, and no longer cast doubt on her"}]}

{"items":[{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(a)","exact_quote":"Applicant accumulated more than $39,400 in delinquent debts after his July 2002 Chapter 7 bankruptcy discharge of almost $60,000 in earlier debt."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(b)","exact_quote":"He submitted no evidence of willingness or ability to satisfy any of these debts."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(c)","exact_quote":"Applicant's history of inability or unwillingness to pay his debts spans more than nine years, and continues to date."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 19(e)","exact_quote":"Applicant's present financial problems arose during a period when he was continuously employed, and resulted from his admitted failure to conform his spending to his available means."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(a)","exact_quote":"He provided no evidence this would not continue or recur, so this mitigating condition is not supported by the record."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(b)","exact_quote":"He did not provide an explanation for his failure to make payments, or documentation demonstrating any attempt to resolve his substantial delinquent debt."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(c)","exact_quote":"Applicant offered no evidence to support application of this provision."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(d)","exact_quote":"The record is devoid of evidence of any effort at resolution of any SOR- alleged debt."},{"condition_code":"AG ¶ 20(e)","exact_quote":"Applicant submitted no evidence to support application of this provision, and admitted owing all of the SOR-alleged debts."}]}
